name: Forked Mudrock Tongue
summary: Forked Mudrock Tongues come from Mudrock turtles along the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. Morgan Stern wants them for a new soup he hopes to serve in Stormwind.

sections.title: A Cook’s Request
sections.body: Morgan Stern is seeking forked Mudrock Tongues in Theramore. He believes they have a distinct flavor and wants to try them in his Mudrock Soup and Bugs. The turtles live along the coast, mostly around the bay.

faq.q: Where do forked Mudrock Tongues come from?
faq.answer: They come from Mudrock turtles along the coast of Dustwallow Marsh, mostly around the bay.

faq.q: Why does Morgan Stern want them?
faq.answer: Morgan Stern wants to test their distinct flavor in his Mudrock Soup and Bugs.
Morgan Stern is a cook in Theramore working on a dish called Mudrock Soup and Bugs.

faq.q: Where does Morgan hope to serve the dish?
faq.answer: Morgan hopes to serve Mudrock Soup and Bugs at the Blue Recluse in Stormwind.

angles.text: As a cook, you may wonder what flavor Morgan hopes to draw from these tongues. He is testing techniques to bring out their distinct taste for his Mudrock Soup and Bugs.
